purpose: freeze the split seed and materialize the exact TRAIN-only router split so Phase 25 cannot choose a split based on observed performance
split_seed_rationale: MASTER_DEVELOPMENT_SEED = 42 is frozen NOW, before Phase 25. It is used for the ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT / ROUTER_HOLDOUT split, the 3-fold refiner cross-fitting, the router-internal deterministic data ordering and the pre-registered bootstrap. It matches the project-wide seed policy (configs/research_protocol.json seed_policy=42) and the Phase-21 seed42 clean_v3 run.
pre_existing_split_note: No repository split with a different seed existed. The default 42 therefore applies and no superseding seed is recorded.
split_algorithm: Per domain: group rows by the composite group key; sort groups by sha256('42::<group_key>'); greedily assign whole groups to ROUTER_HOLDOUT until the domain holdout target round(0.15 * n_domain) is reached or exceeded by one group; assign the remainder to ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT. Groups are never split.
group_key: Composite: PATIENT::<patient_id> when patient_id is a real id (KUB, 318 patients); else ASSET::<duplicate_asset_group_id> or RISK::<duplicate_risk_group_id> when the leakage-safe duplicate ledger assigns one; else SINGLETON::<dataset>::<sample_id>. patient_id is 'NOT_AVAILABLE' for BUSI/ISIC/KVASIR, so it cannot serve as a group key there; the composite key is the only defensible leakage-safe grouping.
stratification_key: dataset (domain); 4 strata = BUSI, ISIC, KUB, KVASIR
